name: DECIDE® Platform (NUARI)
description: Norwich University Applied Research Institutes (NUARI) web-based distributed cyber defense exercise platform. Enables organizations to conduct scalable, realistic cyber exercises for training decision-makers in cyber crisis response. Used by DHS and the Army Cyber Institute to develop cyber situational awareness and cross-organizational coordination capabilities across geographically distributed teams.
general_score_metric: facilitator_assessment (qualitative score-based exercise evaluation / instructor-rated performance)
reputation: Trusted U.S. government cyber exercise platform; adopted by DHS and Army Cyber Institute
notes: DECIDE stands for Distributed Environment for Critical Infrastructure Decision-making Exercises. Supports both fully online and hybrid exercise formats for organizations of varying sizes.
